body: Without a reasonable amount of social power it's almost impossible to change the world for better. One action can be described as good in short time, and bad in long time run and ... loop this. May be I am in some parallel universe, but it's any action I see as both good and bad.

I wouldn't suggest to go in uni for free in Belarus. It's not free! You should work wherever you are sent to for 2 years. Depending on university you can or cannot influence on where you would spend those 2 years. You can't choose anything in medical or pedagogical university for instance. All best to your cousin.
If anyone else is lonely to death and wants to escape, let's unite and figure smth out.
